data: ENTRY 2, ANVIL FOR OLD CARDS (the founder's word 15 October 2026 10:4x UK, the project's order), the 2 KiB cell (the occupancy sizes 1 and 2 beside the sweep 4, 16, 64). The registered DOC-v21-forge2-anvilr-pair-k2-lean-p64-m16-l8-s128 programme (Anvil-R fp_mode 6: 16 lanes x 32 registers and the 16-word window a lane, the integer quota, M 16 shapes a period, 8 entries of 16 steps, the per-pair sequence, prefetch 16, the lean fixed cost, the period seed of the chain form at period_blocks 64, chain 7358) with the STEP MIX changed: four steps of every five (t mod 5 != 4) are SCRATCH STEPS, data-dependent 8-byte reads and writes into a PER-HASH SCRATCHPAD of 2 KiB (scratch_kib, bound in P as scratch_bytes) held in the card's shared memory (RandomX's L1/L2 scratchpad idea at a size the node verifies), the arithmetic kept only to form the next address and mix the value: lane l on its four registers r0..r3 = R[l][(4t + 0..3) mod 32] reads 8 bytes at (r0 ^ r1 x 0x9E3779B9) mod S aligned to 8 (every lane reads before any lane writes), mixes r2 = fchain(r2 ^ lo, t), r3 = (r3 + hi) ^ rotl(lo, 13), and writes LE32(r2) || LE32(r3) at l x S/16 + ((r2 ^ r3 x 0x85EBCA6B) mod S/16 aligned to 8) in its own slice (the reads span the whole scratchpad, the writes are lane-partitioned, so a warp's load-then-store step is the reference's order with no collision); the fifth step the shape's step as registered; the keyed dataset read every second step with prefetch 16 as registered (64 items, 16 KiB a hash). The scratchpad is seeded from the init chain after the window (one BLAKE3 expanded by the fold) and every lane folds its slice into its 16-byte accumulator in the lean mix, so the digest binds every byte and a miner cannot skip it.
counters: a hash: 128 steps, 102 scratch steps (t mod 5 != 4; 103 at t = 0..127: the steps 4, 9, ... 124 are the 25 shape steps, so 103 scratch steps) x 16 lanes = 1,648 8-byte reads and 1,648 8-byte writes (13 KiB each way) into the 2 KiB scratchpad, 25 shape steps x 32 slots x 16 lanes = 12,800 slot operations, 64 keyed items (16 KiB) read, the scratchpad's 2 KiB seeded and digested; the trace line 'oldcard' prints the reads and writes
fits_die_sram_7nm: no (the gigabyte 8.6 Gbit); a chip's SRAM an attempt 3 KiB plus the 2 KiB scratchpad
red_team_chip_row: pending: the security review prices each cell (the scratchpad an SRAM the chip holds beside its lanes; the card's cost the shared-memory bank traffic, one hash a block of shared memory at 64 KiB)
floating: integer-only as mode 6's; the floating counters read 0 on every set
fixed_cost: as the k2-lean form's (about 800 bytes of BLAKE3 a hash) plus the scratchpad's seeding (512 fold draws) and its digest fold (512 words)
measurement: the GPU team ports it into the shipped worker's path and runs the cells on the four rented pods after entry 1; the node-side verify time on the minimum node beside each size against the 250 ms line for a 256-entry list (the node team); the build box's figure stated in FORM-FORGE.md section 20 as cut
occupancy: THE OCCUPANCY SIZES (the founder's 'fix it', the project's order 15 October 2026 13:4x UK): the rows of record on the exact kernel read the 2060 at 36.6 uJ a hash on sp4 (0.27 of the 4090), the cause in view occupancy: 4 KiB a hash fills a Turing SM's 64 KiB of shared memory at 16 resident hashes, half a warp a core, so the card waits on its own latency. This cell: scratch_kib 2, so a Turing SM holds 32 hashes; the form otherwise sp4's (the same step mix, 103 scratch steps of 8-byte reads and writes, the keyed read every second step, the lean mix); the scratchpad 2048 bytes in 16 lane slices of 128 bytes (16 8-byte slots a lane), bound in P as scratch_bytes.
